envelope.author: nico
envelope.reason: 'as before' was false: on omp @default is the host's default role, not the parent session's model; and install must write the file the harness reads, since omp prefers config.yml over config.yaml and a new config.yml shadows a host's config.yaml

payload.gloss: the position an agent holds, carried to a harness as the key its host routes a model by. Each agent's projected definition names the role it holds as a model-role alias, followed by the harness's default role as the fallback, so a host that never configured the role runs the agent on the harness's default role. Install adds, in the configuration file the harness actually reads (never a new file that would shadow one it already reads), for every held role the host lacks, an entry aliasing the harness's nearest built-in role (on omp: implementer to task, planner to plan, assayer and architect to default), never changes an entry the host has set, and reports what it added. Which model fills a role is the host's choice; the projection names no model.
